captured_from: SYNTHETIC (not a container capture): a minimal TLS Alert record (content type 0x15, per RFC 8446 SS5.1's registry -- 0x16 is Handshake, 0x15 is Alert), the shape a server sends when it rejects a ClientHello outright (e.g. no shared cipher suite, or TLS 1.3 not supported). Deliberately not captured live: forcing a real server to answer with an Alert to this probe's own well-formed ClientHello would require a second, deliberately incompatible server setup out of scope for this task. Pins AC-4.13 ("never guess"): a same-length, same-shaped-prefix record that isn't a ServerHello must not match.
